stagingDiagnosticResidue.reason: RP-108 (2026-09-07): temporary diagnostic slugs left on staging by the 2026-08-30 VTO provider benchmark. They have no source in this tree and never did, so they are not governed here — but they WERE deployed on staging and this file did not name them, which meant a read of it under-counted the live surface by three. Recorded so a fresh clone can account for every slug staging actually carries. vto-provider-diag is documented in docs/vto-provider-benchmark.md §3.7, where it was redeployed as an inert 410 stub; rapidapi-key-diag and rapidapi-current-audit were undocumented anywhere in the repository before this entry.
stagingDiagnosticResidue.posture: vto-provider-diag: verify_jwt=true. rapidapi-key-diag and rapidapi-current-audit: verify_jwt=false, i.e. invokable without a caller JWT. All three were read from the Management API read-only during RP-108; none was invoked, redeployed or deleted by that lane.
stagingDiagnosticResidue.ownerAction: Remove all three slugs from staging (yzqjvdfgefveprobvvyw). This is an owner action: RP-108 has no authority to delete Edge Functions, and the Supabase MCP surface exposes no delete_edge_function tool. They are absent from production.

canonicalBranchNote: GOV-KPLUS-001 CLOSED (2026-09-08, BACKEND-AUTHORITY-RECOVERY-05A). The original canonical branch, rebuild/staging-v2-backend, was proven unresolvable -- not on origin, not locally, not in reflog, not as any other ref -- by RP-108 (2026-09-07) and independently re-confirmed by Repair 05 (2026-09-08, docs/staging-rebuild/repair05-canonical-authority-reconfirmation-2026-09-08.md), which additionally ruled out all 12 branches then self-declaring role=backend-deployment-authority as either already-absorbed into this release line or stale. Rather than repair the unrecoverable branch, a fresh authority was bootstrapped from this release line's own already-certified governed backend snapshot at e1bc60565678bcdaa216b76a3ceea437f003e35f and published as rebuild/backend-authority-v2 -- see docs/staging-rebuild/backend-authority-v2-provenance-2026-09-08.md on that branch for the full provenance, and scripts/verify-backend-authority.js reports it as fully resolved (ok: true, zero findings) once fetched. This field is updated to point at it so a fresh clone of this release line is not directed at a dead ref; this checkout's own role remains integration-convergence-non-authoritative and its deploy tooling continues to refuse deployment -- this change does not grant this checkout deployment authority.
